content.short: Artemis is an institutional crypto analytics terminal for stablecoin flows, protocol fundamentals, and chain activity.
content.description: Artemis is a crypto analytics platform built for institutional research, not trader dashboards, founded in 2022 and used by asset managers, consultancies, and issuers. It standardises fundamentals such as revenue, fees, total value locked, active users, and developer activity across more than twelve thousand tokens and fifty blockchains so assets can actually be compared side by side. Stablecoin flow data is a particular strength, and access runs through a no-code terminal, a real-time API, and native Excel and Google Sheets plugins.
